Long, straight silver-grey hair with a clean center part. Calm, gentle sea-blue eyes with a serene expression. Appears to be in late adolescence with a soft, mature countenance. Slender, elegant build. A pristine white and navy blue naval officer's uniform with a gold-trimmed cape and a matching officer's cap. Includes a large, mechanical ship-rigging apparatus with sleek gun turrets and a long, sturdy mechanical tail-like rudder.
BODY COLOR: fair porcelain
